description: Fifth attempt at the CM-MNIST two-epoch sanity gate: head of the automatic chain that also queues the thirty formal units at full (30-way) concurrency.
notes: Source commit 3ee4c2dc5af5f3caa4522971d305b97c6de40da6 in pinned worktree dynamic_baselines_3ee4c2d; preflight array 61726135 (0-3%4) and aggregate 61726136 head the chain preflight -> preaggregate -> formal array 61726137 (0-29%30) -> formal aggregate 61726138.

Fixes carried by this commit: the compute-node guard is resolved from AIM3_ROOT instead of ${BASH_SOURCE[0]} (sbatch executes a copy under /var/lib/slurm/slurmd), and a failed Conda initialization writes its own fail marker because a failed `source` bypasses the ERR trap.
Failures that motivated this version: 61717748 (hard-coded /usr/bin/git) and 61723339 (BASH_SOURCE-based guard path); both left 0/4 valid units and no task fail markers.
